name: qiaomu-cut
title_zh: 一句话需求变成可验收的视频工程
tagline_zh: 你说“做个产品发布短片”，它直接给出分镜、素材路线和渲染方案。不写脚本、不猜风格，每一步都能核对、能回放。
tagline_en: Say "make a launch video" and get a shot list, asset plan, and render path — every step checkable, every cut.
desc_en: 把一句话需求转成可复现、可验收视频工程的乔木智能剪辑导演。Use when the user asks to create, plan, edit, remix, explain, narrate, subtitle, animate, composite, or render a video; build English-learning movie mixes, person profiles, explainers, product launch videos, cinematic shorts, social clips, course/PPT videos, AI image/video/TTS/music-assisted stories, stock-footage stories, or multi-source montage. Routes across 33台词, C
why_zh: 把模糊需求拆成可验收的中间产物：分镜表、素材清单、渲染参数。每一步有明确输入输出。
why_en: Turns vague asks into verifiable artifacts — storyboard, asset list, render specs — with explicit inputs/outputs at each step.
limit_zh: 只认视频域：剪辑、混剪、字幕、动画、合成、渲染。素材来源依赖 33 台词等外部接口，离线或接口失效时无法取景。
limit_en: Video domain only: editing, remix, subtitles, animation, compositing, rendering. Depends on external APIs like 33台词 for footage; no offline asset.
